lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 high-contrast vertical white lines are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is relatively wider in the anterior section and becomes progressively narrower and more irregular toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation occurs in the lower-central torso region where two vertical lines merge into a single terminal segment; a second point of convergence is visible on the mid-posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior vertical lines exhibit significant fragmentation, transitioning into series of isolated spots before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 10-12 white spots is visible on the upper posterior hind limb and lower haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of four distinct spots is visible across the mid-thigh, forming a semi-continuous geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white facial spots are located on the malar region inferior to the eye, accompanied by a prominent white transverse patch on the lower neck and white banding on the lower limbs.
